hook.line: Everyone is asking what SEO is, where to put it, how to hide it.
hook.visual: Woman in a car tying her hair up while talking, bold word captions plus a fixed '1 step to INSTANT growth!' and red 'SEO tutorial' label

beats.what: In-car selfie, tying hair up while listing the questions people ask
Phone screen recording inset at top left: the TikTok search box
Inset shows the 'others searched for' suggestions to screenshot
Inset shows adding text and typing the phrases
Inset: shrink the text and push it off screen so it stays hidden
Inset: drag the text track across the whole timeline
Single cut; inset gone, face only for the why and the payoff

why_it_works: Doing something casual (tying her hair) in the first seconds is an off-script move that stops the scroll
A 'hidden text' trick feels like a secret, which drives saves and shares
Small screen recording inset keeps her face as the main frame while showing every tap
Fixed headline label stays on screen the whole time, so late joiners know what the video is
weaknesses: Only one cut in 88 s; energy relies entirely on fast talk (4.4 words/s)
The inset is small; the steps are hard to read on a phone
Several CTAs stacked at the end (save, comment, follow)
for_robert: A small screen inset in a corner beside the face works for how-to beats; Fred could swim to the inset and point at the tap.
